verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships a software product (Visalaw AI), so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question and the axis applies. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at visalaw.com/llms.txt) and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The marketing pages describe in-product agent features, not machine-readable docs for an external agent to consume. Confidence is medium because the probes covered visalaw.com rather than the visalaw.ai product domain.
